summary: Comprehensive plan discussion: Pro environment, short naming, simple LST and geological composites
details: User requests continuing from report 0030 and shared chat discussion to formulate a comprehensive revision of PLAN-0019 r2 covering: (1) ArcGIS Pro rasterio environment fix and validation message placement; (2) shortened result filenames [StudyArea_]index_date.tif and optional Study Area Name across all tools; (3) automatic NDVI calculation and simple LST workflow; (4) simplified geological composites focused on standard band combinations and ratios per sensor without complex enhancement sliders; (5) discussion and alignment before implementation.
